ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary File Download Via PresentationHost.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of "PresentationHost" which is a utility that runs ".xbap" (Browser Applications) files to download arbitrary files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\presentationhost\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "PresentationHost\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ftp\\:\\/\\/.*")))
